A '''microdot homing beacon''' was a tiny [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] that was deployed by [[Moon moth espionage droid|moon moth]] [[espionage droid]]s. A moon moth carried six of the beacons in its "abdomen", and the beacons were deployed when the moon moth landed on a target. Each beacon had a coded [[Hyperwave/Legends|hyperwave]] signal that could be detected from [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] away.<ref name="EGTD" />
